name: internet-platform-expansion-2026-06-25
purpose: Platform expansion candidates found from upstream extractor ecosystems and public URL patterns. These cases are evidence-gathering inputs, not claims that every platform is currently supported.

cases.name: dailymotion-public-video-hint
cases.notes: Upstream extractor target. Sample is a public video URL pattern; must be revalidated before promoting to platform smoke.

cases.name: peertube-blender-public-video-hint
cases.notes: PeerTube instance discovery starts as page_html/browser observation until a stable public video fixture is chosen.

cases.name: archive-org-public-domain-video-hint
cases.notes: Archive.org public-domain style item. Keep experimental until selected format size is controlled.

cases.name: wayback-example-page-html-hint
cases.notes: Wayback replay pages are page archives first. Use CDX/Availability metadata before promoting any captured media/file extraction.

cases.name: wayback-cdx-api-hint
cases.notes: CDX JSON should become a structured extractor target; this catalog entry only validates URL routing and safe page capture behavior.

cases.name: archive-it-cdx-collection-hint
cases.notes: Archive-It CDX/C should stay collection-scoped. Do not rely on broad /all queries for smoke or production behavior.

cases.name: perma-public-archives-api-hint
cases.notes: Perma public archives endpoint is read-only and unauthenticated. Treat results as citation/page metadata, not media extraction.

cases.name: archive-today-search-page-hint
cases.notes: archive.today/archive.ph has no stable official JSON API in current research. Keep as page_html and avoid JS-heavy media assumptions.

cases.name: ghostarchive-public-archive-page-hint
cases.notes: Ghostarchive replay uses browser-oriented archive pages. Capture as page_html first; do not assume video availability.

cases.name: webcitation-legacy-page-hint
cases.notes: WebCitation is a legacy read-only target and no longer accepts new archiving requests.

cases.name: memento-timegate-doc-page-hint
cases.notes: Memento is a protocol hint. Future support should parse Link headers and TimeMap responses; this entry validates page_html routing.

cases.name: wikimedia-commons-media-page-hint
cases.notes: Wikimedia Commons file pages should become a stable direct/media discovery target after one verified fixture is selected.

cases.name: reddit-public-video-hint
cases.notes: Do not promote to media smoke until a non-NSFW stable public post URL is selected.

cases.name: imgur-public-gallery-page-hint
cases.notes: Gallery/image platforms should use page_html/browser observation until gallery-dl-style image extraction is implemented.

cases.name: flickr-commons-page-hint
cases.notes: Flickr Commons is a safe source pool for later stable image fixtures; current case only validates hint and page archive behavior.

cases.name: bandcamp-public-page-hint
cases.notes: Bandcamp needs a specific artist track/album fixture with explicit public preview before media smoke.

cases.name: mixcloud-public-page-hint
cases.notes: Mixcloud route is hint-only until a stable public show fixture is selected and tested.

cases.name: spotify-oembed-page-hint-no-media
cases.notes: Spotify is metadata/page-only in Reflection King; do not add audio extraction or stream-ripping behavior.
